rationale: The Court is likely to hold that, absent a categorical misdefinition of “persecution,” the agency’s record-specific severity line-drawing is reviewed under § 1252(b)(4)(B)’s substantial-evidence standard, with de novo review reserved for genuine legal errors. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters (to press the mixed-question/uniformity concern) and from Justice Gorsuch or Justice Thomas to sharpen the law/fact boundary and the limited “legal error” carveout.
